evidence: CDIAL 6152 danta gives Gujarati/Marathi/Hindi dā̃t tooth. The printed source has dental d/t, matching this family.
CDIAL 5798.4 tāraka gives Gujarati tāro and Hindi/Marathi tārā star. The printed source has dental t, selecting the regular western masculine branch.
CDIAL 6391 dugdha gives Gujarati/Marathi dūdh and unaspirated regional dud/dūd milk. The printed source has dental d̪, including its Hindi/Gujarati/Marathi control forms.
CDIAL 10702 rātrī gives Gujarati/Marathi/Hindi rāt night. The printed source has dental final t̪.
CDIAL 10539 rakta gives Gujarati rātũ, regional rato red. The printed Gomon form has dental t̪, not the retroflex stop in the stored transcription.

CDIAL 13139 sapta gives Gujarati/Marathi/Hindi sāt seven. The printed source has dental t̪; the Noiri/Dungra h-initial forms are compared jointly with the neighboring s-initial series, with regional transmission open.
